globalAnalysis.visualFlow: Bodies and raft timbers build a diagonal pyramid from death in the foreground toward the raised signal at the upper right.
globalAnalysis.curatorialNote: Low registers should carry raft and death, increasingly urgent human motifs should climb toward the signal, and storm/sea should remain a threatening surrounding layer.

cells.label: Storm light behind the sail
cells.interpretation: A narrow opening of light is pressed between storm cloud and sail.

cells.label: Mast and heavy sail
cells.interpretation: Mast, rope, and sail form a severe vertical structure against the storm.

cells.label: Dark storm above the survivors
cells.interpretation: The darkest cloud weighs directly over upward-reaching bodies.

cells.label: Signal against the storm
cells.interpretation: The highest survivor thrusts a red signal into the dark horizon.

cells.label: Sail over rough water
cells.interpretation: The sail's hard diagonal strains against the horizontal sea.

cells.label: Crowd beneath the mast
cells.interpretation: Compressed figures gather beneath the mast and begin the human ascent.

cells.label: Bodies climbing toward hope
cells.interpretation: Arms and torsos build a rising chain toward the signal.

cells.label: Signal group at the horizon
cells.interpretation: The living cluster reaches upward against a narrow band of distant light.

cells.label: Bodies at the waterline
cells.interpretation: Exhausted bodies lie against the unstable boundary of sea and raft.

cells.label: Despairing father and dead youth
cells.interpretation: A collapsed human pair forms the emotional counterweight to the rising signal.

cells.label: Central struggle
cells.interpretation: Bodies turn from collapse toward the upward movement of hope.

cells.label: Exhausted bodies at the edge
cells.interpretation: Bodies slope downward toward the exposed outer edge of the raft.

cells.label: Dead at the breaking sea
cells.interpretation: Still bodies meet the agitated white water in the foreground.

cells.label: Broken timber and fallen bodies
cells.interpretation: Angular timbers cut through the weight of fallen bodies.

cells.label: Raft structure under human weight
cells.interpretation: The improvised geometry barely supports the dense human mass.

cells.label: Timbers over dark water
cells.interpretation: Broken timbers project beyond the last body into threatening water.
